instruction: Candid outdoor portrait, close-up side profile. She carries the toddler girl in the pink turban beanie and skull-print jumpsuit (R2) piggyback on her back. The toddler smiles happily, looking forward in the same direction. Bright natural light illuminates the scene against a background of fallen leaves and trees.
